integrity: The homotopy claim is supported by a complete enumeration of all gradient vector fields and an exhaustive acyclicity check of a face-poset matching. A separate mod-\(2\) boundary-rank computation is included as a consistency check; no finite sampling is used.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns only the ordinary Morse complex of the octahedral graph \(O=K_{2,2,2}\). It does not assert a family formula for complete multipartite or cocktail-party graphs, nor a statement about generalized Morse complexes.
title: The octahedral graph Morse complex is a wedge of \(675\) four-spheres
